title: Native virtualization runtime enforcement
summary: Operationally enforce the existing VIRTUALIZATION-SOVEREIGNTY-001 rule so an eligible healthy EKODI-owned virtualization provider must be used and external virtualization cannot be selected merely by convenience.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly instructed EKODI on 2026-09-23 to continue development and make it a mandatory rule that, when virtualization is needed, EKODI should use its own virtualization instead of external virtualization.
constitutionalInterpretation: This amendment does not introduce a new constitutional principle or version. It hardens runtime enforcement of the already-approved EKODI-owned virtualization sovereignty principle in Constitution v1.20.0.
enforcementAdds: external fallback forbidden while an eligible native provider is healthy
all eligible native paths must be explicitly unusable before external fallback
audit id and native capability-gap record required for any external fallback
external fallback must retry native on the next eligible execution
rollbackPlan: Revert the runtime routing policy/router/validators as one guarded C2 change while retaining VIRTUALIZATION-SOVEREIGNTY-001. Never roll back to a state where external virtualization can silently become the default or bypass audit, native-gap tracking, or security equivalence.
